notes.title: New AI feature - Patch 4.1.0 Notes - 08/08
notes.notes:
Request pass feature

If your AI teammate has the ball, a button will appear next to player(s) that you control to request the AI player to pass the ball to you. They will attempt to pass the ball to you in the best way possible, if you are the first character to request the ball. A foot icon will flash on your player circle, to show other players in your team that you requested a pass.

You can also follow us over on Twitter to keep up to date with everything that is going on, from drop in sessions to schedules of streamers playing the game for you to watch.

notes.notes:
One Touch & Headers

We have increased the randomness of the one touch & header actions. The accuracy for characters with lower attributes should now be more punishing.


Scoreboard alignment

We have fixed a visual alignment of the scoreboard at half time.


This is the final patch before we push the game to full release. We wanted to take the opportunity to thank the community for the feedback during this period and hope to see the game grow further!

notes.title: Cleaning out the bugs - Patch 4.0.2 Notes - 03/16
notes.notes:
Movement changes

The momentum formula has been changed to provide a more gradual & consistent impact to move distance after a player changes direction. Previously, player momentum would not significantly decrease when changing direction.


Private match bugs

Resolved multiple bugs related to private match lobbies which caused lobbies to crash or players unable to enter the match.


Long shot bug

We have fixed a bug related to long shots, which prevented players from moving in the later phases.


Action change bug

We have fixed a bug which caused some actions to be displayed out of sync if the user decision was too close to the end of the turn.


Receive bug

Fixed a bug related to quick play which allowed a user to intercept a high pass in the red zone.


Losing attributes

Fixed a bug which reverted some player attributes to 0 if they were at a multiple of 10.


Moments videos

We have updated the start of the tutorial moments scenarios with some new videos.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there. You can also follow us over on Twitter to keep up to date with everything that is going on, from drop in sessions to schedules of streamers playing the game for you to watch.

notes.title: A new way to PLAY! - Patch 4.0.1 Notes - 02/24
notes.notes:
Quick Play UI

 A new way to play the game has been added for the tutorial and regular gameplay, called quick play.
 When enabled, our AI will provide 3 suggestions to the player to choose from. Users can still choose to play the “classic” tutorial and can be toggled in the settings before a match if they want to change.


Homepage layout

 Challenge mode has been renamed to the starter league and is now the main tile on the home screen.
 Credit rewards are automatically given to the users who perform best in the starter league.
 

Connectivity improvements

 We have included the option to rejoin private & starter league matches - like you can for competitive games. We have also resolved a bug causing some matchmaking games not to start.


Movement bug

 We fixed a visual bug related to the distance players can move. Sometimes it would not be in sync with the match engine and caused some unexpected behaviour for players without the ball. 


AI bugs

 Some of the AI specific match engine bugs have been resolved. We will continue to investigate and improve the AI decision logic in future releases.


11v11 Camera zoom

 We have changed the default camera zoom level for 11v11 matches. This can still be changed during the match if you want.


Help videos

 We have added help videos to some key pages, to explain some important features in more detail.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there. You can also follow us over on Twitter to keep up to date with everything that is going on, from drop in sessions to schedules of streamers playing the game for you to watch.

notes.title: More work on the AI! - Patch 3.8.0 Notes - 12/28
notes.notes:
Movement changes

 We have completely reworked the formula for player movement and momentum. We now have unique formulas for 11v11 & 5v5 to provide a more balanced experience. In 5v5 the movement will be noticeably less, as we received feedback that it felt too extreme with high momentum.
 Acceleration is now much more important when a player has low momentum. The speed attribute will dictate the max running speed and become more important with high momentum. Agility is only used for changing direction and does not impact the max running speed.


Faster turns

 If only 1 user is on a team, the turn will end once an action is made rather than waiting the full 6 seconds. If the user has multiple characters, the turn won’t end unless all the characters have made a move or the 6 seconds have passed.


AI improvements

 The GK characters controlled by AI should now position themselves better and make better attempts at saving shots. AI characters will no longer receive one touch & header actions incorrectly. The positioning of AI characters on kick-off should be more realistic depending on their position and the team formation.


Long shots

 We have changed the logic in our match engine to calculate long shots. Previously it depended on the area of the pitch a shot was taken from. However, now it will be purely based on the distance from the goal.


Manager level pop-up

 Fixed a bug with the manager level-up pop-up showing repeatedly after logging in.


Challenge mode

 We now show a warning message if a user starts a challenge mode match without adding a character.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there. You can also follow us over on Twitter to keep up to date with everything that is going on, from drop in sessions to schedules of streamers playing the game for you to watch.

notes.title: Christmas has come early! - Patch 3.7.0 Notes - 11/30
notes.notes:
Match engine Christmas list

 We asked our users on Discord for adjustments they’d like to see in the match engine. Here are the changes we have made:
 Technique has slightly less impact on most actions with the ball
 GK Save has been buffed, so less reaction distance is required to increase the chances of a successful save
 One touch shots are now up to 10% faster than regular shots


Ball path colours

 We have fixed some issues with the ball path colour of crosses and GK throws. The shade of colour should now be consistent with the areas that can be blocked.


Training drill loading times

 We’ve made some adjustments to reduce the loading time of tutorial training drills.


Drill 7 help

 We noticed a large percentage of new players failing the 7th training drill in the tutorial. We’ve added additional text help.


Formation bugs

 We have fixed a few minor issues when switching formations during a match.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there. You can also follow us over on Twitter to keep up to date with everything that is going on, from drop in sessions to schedules of streamers playing the game for you to watch.

Headgear

Goal posts

Competitive tab

 The competitive tab tiles will order by the next scheduled match, if you have characters in multiple clubs. The next match will be displayed at the top.


Post match stats

Club stars

Retire

Hotkeys

notes.title: Are you up for the challenge? Give it your best shot - Patch 3.5.0 Notes - 09/05
notes.notes:
Challenge mode

 We’ve added a new game mode to give users a way to play with friends against AI teams, with the chance to win credits every season. We see this as a stepping stone for new users to get used to playing with others but also something for experienced users to grind and earn back credits. After each game, each user will earn or lose rating points and at the end of each season we will reward the best performing users with credits.  
 We are working to make improvements and bug fixes to our AI, to compliment this new game mode. Our AI developers have been impacted by the war in Ukraine, so we appreciate your patience and will try to complete the work as soon as possible.


Match ping

 New feature for players to use during matches, so that you can quickly point out to teammates a position on the pitch. One use case for this feature will be to indicate where you want to receive a pass, but there are plenty of other situations it may be handy. Just hold down the ALT key and left click your mouse on the pitch to ping a position. Enable the option in system settings.


Tutorial videos

 We’ve included some short videos to the tutorial of the game, to explain certain features in a bit more detail for new users.


Attribute Decay

 Fixed a bug for how attributes are selected for decay, as characters get older.


Post match screen

 Fixed a bug where the formations and player positions would sometimes be displayed for the opposite team.


Additional position
Fixed a bug where the additional position points were displaying incorrectly for some characters.
As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there. You can also follow us over on Twitter to keep up to date with everything that is going on, from drop in sessions to schedules of streamers playing the game for you to watch.

notes.title: You only get one touch, so make it count! - Patch 3.4.0 Notes - 08/04
notes.notes:
One touch & heading

 One touch actions changes the turn order of the game for a turn. After a one touch move, the defending team has to move first rather than the attacking team. For a one touch move, the player interacting with the ball has to make his action instantly (like the GK does with a parry). Heading is also a one touch move, which can only be used from a high pass/cross. 
 One touch moves are more punishing than regular moves. So if you attempt a one touch pass with low attributes, it has a higher chance of deviating. There is also an increased chance of the player missing the ball completely. 


Fight for ball adjustments

 The one touch and heading actions will give a 10% boost to the FFB stats of a competing player. We have also provided a 10% boost to the first player arriving at the location of the FFB. 
 Players will also receive a 10% boost if they are fighting for a ball with at least one teammate, against a single opponent. However, if there are multiple players from both clubs in the FFB, then no boost will be provided for any players.


Match rating

 We’ve made changes to the match rating calculations for some aspects of the game. We feel like goalkeepers were getting overly punished and it was too hard to improve morale once it was low. Attacking players were getting 10.0 ratings too often. 
 Successful parry actions will give a net positive rating to goalkeepers, even if the parry goes to an opposition player
 Conceding a goal while failing a save or parry will be less punishing than conceding a goal without interacting with the ball
 Defenders now lose 0.5 rather than 0.8 match rating when a goal is conceded
 Goals scored, assists & shots on target have been slightly reduced for side midfielders
 Goals scored & shots on target have been slightly reduced for centre midfielders
 Goals scored, assists, shots on target & successful receives have been slightly reduced for centre forwards


Player numbers

 On club match lobbies, you can now hover over a player to see the shirt number.


Server upgrades

 We’ve made more improvements to our server infrastructure. This was our priority for the last few weeks of the league, as we know how frustrating match freezes are!


Substitutes

 Fixed a bug where substitutes would be stuck on pending, for human and bot characters.


Commentary colours

 Fixed a bug with some broken colour codes on the game commentary.


R Hotkey 

 Fixed a bug which was preventing the R key being available to use as a hotkey.

Game commentary

Bot teams

Skip AI phase

 This option is now enabled by default, to make games with bots go faster.


System settings

Training match

 Fixed a bug with the timer in training match, when the Skip AI option is enabled.


Rejoin matches

 We’ve fixed a bug for rejoining and spectating tournament matches.


Trial contracts

 We have fixed a bug when accepting trial contracts for bot teams.
 

As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there. notes.title: Speeding up single player matches! - Patch 3.3.0 Notes - 04/14
notes.notes:
Skip AI phase

 When only AI characters are making a decision during a phase, we’ve shortened the timer to 2 seconds. This will make single player games run a lot quicker. This option is enabled by default, but can be switched off in the system settings if you’d prefer the extra time to analyse between turns.


Training drill audio

 We’ve added some more audio to the training drill tutorials, to provide more tips to new players as they learn the mechanics.


Server upgrades

 We’ve made significant improvements to our server infrastructure. These changes should provide smoother gameplay going forward. This may lead to a few issues in the short term, which we’ll fix as a priority


Attribute decay

 We’ve fixed a bug for characters over 38yo, who weren’t losing attributes correctly. The attribute decay function has been fixed and we’ve run a script to correct these values retroactively.

Post match screen

 New layout & design for the post match stats. More information on match stats are presented, as well as the existing player stats.


Ball & Player visibility

 After feedback from new users, we’ve made the ball more visible with a different colour and animated effect. If a user controls more than one character on the pitch, the characters will have a thin outline only visible to them.


Turn timer

Player Numbers

Tutorial moments

Match hotkeys

 Fixed a bug which would duplicate hotkeys when a large number of characters were added by the same user. Also fixed a bug with hotkeys in training match mode.


Training drills

 We’ve updated the text and re-organised some of the GIFs on the 7th training drill.


Slow page loading

notes.title: Introducing training matches and UI updates!- Patch 3.1.0 Notes - 02/08
notes.notes:
Training Match

 A new mode has been created for new users, to bridge the gap between the tutorials and online matches. It’s a single player mode and the user can pick any position to play, without needing to create a character. The user can also disable the turn timer if they’d prefer to get more familiar with the game before adding the time pressure. Of course this game mode can also be useful for our existing users, if they want to try out new positions before purchasing an additional character.


Play Screen

 Competitive matches can now be accessed from the play screen, as well as the new training match mode.
 

Matchmaking 

 The UI of the matchmaking lobby has been updated. We feel this is a more intuitive way to add characters to a team.


Private match

 Users can now join private match lobbies with a unique code, rather than being Steam friends. The UI of the match lobby and game chat has been updated.


Game audio

 We’ve added some audio prompts during the tutorial and the background music has been updated.


GK line bug

 When a goalkeeper interacts with the ball on the goal line, sometimes a goal would be given even if the GK action is successful. This bug should now be resolved.



As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Beginning of Major UI and Tutorial Overhaul - Patch 3.0.0 Notes - 12/10
notes.notes:
In patch 3.0.0 we bring some major changes which are outlined below, including a big update to the home screen, an overhaul of the tutorial system and there are further bug fixes too! 

Home page

 The layout of the home page has been updated to provide more information to users. It also gives new users more direction on what to do, as we received feedback that it was quite overwhelming. Announcements and new updates will be more visible, as well as new/helpful content we add to our Youtube channel.


Tutorial steps

 We’ve optimised the tutorial steps to give users more flexibility. Some of the previous steps have been moved to later in the game.
 

Training drills

 We’ve made some significant improvements to the first part of the tutorials. Our focus has been on user experience and feedback, so new users can understand the game quicker and more enjoyably.


Moments scenarios

 Some improvements have also been made to the moments scenarios in the tutorial flow. These serve as a good transition into playing real matches. The phase timer has been simplified, so users can easily follow what is happening during each turn.


Character creation

 As the final part of the tutorial, we’ve made some UI improvements to the character creation process. This is to give more visibility and information to new users.


Server decisions

 When a user makes a decision right at the end of a phase, sometimes the resulting action would be mixed with the AI decision. We’ve now ensured only 1 decision will be acted upon by our server.


Attribute Decay

 Resolved some issues related to footballers losing attributes as they get older. This includes how attributes were selected and the values removed.


Contract bugs

 Fixed some minor contract bugs related to negotiating wages between footballers and managers.


Diving save

 Fixed the commentary when a GK uses the diving save special.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

Joining our Discord is a great place to meet other players and find people to join your team or for you to find a team to join!

notes.title: Fixing bugs with matches and more!- Patch 2.3.7 Notes - 10/20
notes.notes:
Match connection

 We identified the root cause of the issue, leading to players disappearing at kick off and moves not being taken. When we upgraded our Unity version, there was a knock-on effect causing this bug for users who don’t have English as their default system language.


Attribute training

 Some users identified issues with attribute rounding since the Unity upgrade. There were also some inconsistencies between the attribute page and the daily training page.
 

Adding character bug 

 We fixed a bug in custom lobbies, when 2 users click the same position at the same time. It would allow both users control of the character in that specific position.
 

Inactive user bug

 We identified a bug with the inactive user pop-up. It should give a returning user the option to continue using their character or create a new character.
 

Tournament prize fund

 Some positions in a tournament did not receive prize money. Some other minor prize money bugs have also been fixed.
 



As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

Tournament registration

 We have removed the tournament registration page, so all the functionality is on the main tournament page. This should give managers more clarity on the status of tournaments. Managers can also sign-up for ladder matches directly from the tournament page.


Additional tournament improvements

 We now have more flexibility in how tournaments are managed. Some bugs with the reserve list have been fixed, so we can swap inactive teams from a tournament with a team on the reserve list. We also fixed some bugs related to promotion & relegation spots.

notes.title: Making things more balanced for teams going forward - Patch 2.3.2 Notes - 06/09
notes.notes:
Game changes

 We have removed some features that were in place to help with early access testing.
 Friendly matches are now limited to 10 per week. Managers will get a pop-up to notify them if they have reached the limit. Also, no funds will be earned for a match if the UDP of the team is under 50%. This is to avoid clubs “farming” money with matches they do not intend to play.
 Additional positions can only be learnt in club matches. Custom matches and quick matches will not be counted.
 User credits will no longer be rewarded after playing matches.


Tournament intro

 Fixed a bug where squad numbers are displayed under the player, during the tournament match intro.


Trial contract text

 We’ve added some text to the trial contract pop-up, to give new users more information when they start.


Default squad

 Fixed a bug where the default squad was not being saved for a club.


Action menu cut-off

 The height of the action menu is now dynamic, to avoid users having to scroll if there are a lot of actions available.


GK actions

 The tackle with hands action has been buffed slightly. Also, to avoid confusion the GK will not have a save option when interacting with passes & crosses.


Moments tutorial

 The GK kit has been updated in the Bobby Sparks moment, to avoid confusion between clubs. The turn info panel has been disabled during the initial text help.


Ball path

 Fixed an issue where the ball path would go out of sync in the 3rd phase.

notes.title: Server upgrade time - Patch 2.3.1 Notes - 05/26
notes.notes:
Since the recent introduction of the upgraded AI, we needed to make some improvements to the back-end of the game.


Turn delay


 Resolved an issue with our servers, which caused a noticeable delay/freeze between turns. This was due to the additional stress put on the server by the new AI. We will continue to monitor the situation and will look to make further improvements in the future.

Match hotkeys


 Users can now edit the hotkeys of the players they control during a match. This also includes the hotkey used by a manager, who controls an inactive player with pro license.

Action menu design


 Added a border around the option which the mouse hovers over in the action menu during matches.
 
Attribute decay


 Fixed a few bugs with attribute decay, when characters get older. The current generation of early build characters didn’t lose as many stats as they should have before turning 30.

Quick match lobby 


 Fixed a bug with quick match lobbies, where some data would be out of sync.

As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: New User Ladder Competitions and more - Patch 2.3.0 Notes - 05/19
notes.notes:
Some big updates this week with the introduction of a complete new system for new users to join competitive leagues along with other changes discussed below.

New user ladders

 We’ve created a new way to play the game, to integrate new players into the game quicker & easier. There will be ladder tournaments running throughout the day, which now include bot clubs. These clubs are self-managed by the game and play every day. They start with a group of bot players, but will look to fill the line-up with trial contract players immediately. As part of the character creation tutorial, users will be displayed with 3 contract offers from bot clubs playing in the closest time-slots available. 
 Trial contract players will be able to renew their contract with the bot team through the notification system. If a player becomes inactive or their trial contract expires, the position will be re-advertised on the trial contract page. The system will ensure there is always a club available to join for every position in each ladder tournament. 
 Managers will be able to view the most active players on the transfer market page. Trial contract players can be signed instantly on full contracts.


Join match late 

 We’ve resolved the issue which caused some season matches to crash if a user joined the lobby slightly after kick-off.


Cursor colour

 The cursor will now display a different colour in a block region of the ball path, when receive is not available. There is also a new “default” cursor colour, which we feel is more intuitive for new users. The “classic” colours will still be available as an option in the system settings.
 

Turn info hotkey

 The turn info panel, under the scoreboard, can now be viewed by pressing a hotkey. The default key is F.


Zoom movement

 We have now provided an option to move the camera with the arrow keys, rather than edge pan with your cursor. This is only possible when zooming in is enabled.


Match sounds

 We’ve added some basic match sounds to the game such as crowd noise, referee whistle and half time music.


System Settings 

 The design of the system settings page has been updated, to include the new elements mentioned above.


Group stage UI

 We’ve improved the design of the Cup tournament overview page, during the group stage.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

Joining our Discord is a great place to meet other players and find people to join your team or for you to find a team to join!

notes.title: Our 11-a-side AI has hit the gym - Patch 2.2.12 Notes - 05/12
notes.notes:
11v11 AI

 We have updated the AI logic for 11v11 matches. The logic is slightly different to 5v5 games, mainly due to offside rules. The AI will be updated in all game modes, but we will disable if any issues are found.


Set piece radius

 The area in which an opposition player can’t enter during a set-piece has been increased by around 50%.


Curving change

 Curving now has a direct impact on how easily an opponent player can intercept a pass, cross or shot. This includes goalkeeper actions. Above 50 curving will make it harder for an opponent to intercept, but below 50 curving will make it easier.
 

Action menu

 The design of the action menu has been updated, to be more consistent with other elements in the game.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: New Tournament Type!? Time for Snapshots! - Patch 2.2.11 Notes - 04/23
notes.notes:
This week we bring you a new style of tournament alongside some other changes and bug fixes.


Snapshot tournaments


 As part of the recent attribute changes, we can now run tournaments based on the starting attributes of a player. So all characters will play as if we took a snapshot of their attributes when they were created. The only exception is for existing custom build characters, who will be given all-rounder attributes. Players of any age can play in the snapshot tournaments. Special actions are disabled in snapshot matches. Players can now view their starting attributes on the attribute page.

Ball path


 Fixed a randomness bug, where the ball path would sometimes move slightly after the 2nd phase.

GK throw


 Players no longer have the option to block a goalkeeper throw.
 
Next fixture display


 Fixed a bug on the tournament page, where the wrong date was displayed under the next fixture column.

Tutorial drill


 We now allow users 3 moves to attempt to score in the 6th training drill, rather than 2.

As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Introverts rejoice, you can now hide chat - Patch 2.2.10 Notes - 03/31
notes.notes:
Hide chat

 Users now have the option to hide the game chat during a match by pressing enter and using the checkbox. It will be reset at the start of each match.

Club managers

 Users can now view a manager profile from the club squad page. Main managers can also kick inactive assistants from this page.

Failed actions

 After failing an action like tackle or save, the turn info panel wasn’t displaying the odds which has now been fixed.

Attribute decay

 Some older players were losing attribute points below 0, so we’ve updated the logic to avoid this happening in the future.

Attribute screen

 Some minor tweaks to the alignment of elements on the new attribute screen.

Tutorial moments

 Fixed a bug where the pass/fail status wasn’t updating for some of the moments.

Driven pass

 Fixed the turn info text for the driven pass special action.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Changes to Custom Builds and Attribute Screen - Patch 2.2.9 Notes - 03/24
notes.notes:
AI temporarily disabled

 The new AI we are using in 5v5 has been temporarily disabled in league & cup tournaments. This will avoid disruption to tournaments, while we continue to investigate the invisible arrow issue.


Footballer attribute design 

 We’ve redesigned the footballer attribute screen, so all attributes are displayed on the screen without needing to scroll.


Custom build limit

 We have restricted the maximum starting attribute for custom build players to 91, to be consistent with the rest of the builds. If you are looking to create a new custom character in the near future, we recommend waiting till the next patch. All will be revealed in the next patch!


Red cards

 We have prevented any fouls leading to a straight red card. The only way for a player to be sent off is with 2 yellow cards.


Post alignment

 The alignment of the goal post in 5v5 has been slightly adjusted, after some feedback we received in a tournament match.


Tackle Soft

 The soft tackle action has been slightly nerfed. It does not apply reaction logic and was too strong in some situations.


Transfer list

 Managers can now remove players from the transfer list, if their situation has changed.



As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Character Overview Overhaul - Patch 2.2.8 Notes - 03/18
notes.notes:
This weeks changes:

Character Overview 

 The character screen, where users can view all their characters owned, has had a significant redesign. It has a dynamic view depending on how many characters are owned. We’ve also made it quicker for users to access daily training and view who still has training outstanding.  

Lobby crash

 We identified the root cause of some tournament lobbies crashing. Some of the data would get duplicated, if a user joined the lobby slightly late. We have prevented this, so joining slightly late won’t impact the lobby creation.

Select match days

 As part of the changes to trial contracts, managers can now set the days their club prefers to play. These will be displayed on the trial contract tiles, which new users will see. The days can be set on the trial contract pop-up for managers.

GK Punch

 A bug with the turn info panel has been fixed, when the GK punch action is performed.

Fight for ball

 We’ve fixed a few bugs with the calculations and turn info panel data for fight for ball actions.
 
Diving save

As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Connection issues resolved! - Patch 2.2.7 Notes - 03/05
notes.notes:
Match connection issues

Add Steam user

 You can now add a user on Steam by going to their user profile in game and selecting the add friend button at the bottom of the page. We hope this will make communication between users easier.


Tournament replays

 The post match stats and match replays can now be accessed on the tournament fixtures page.


Display inactive players

Control inactive players

Tutorial screen

 After feedback from multiple new users, we’ve made the main tiles clickable on the tutorial overview screen and added a border to indicate the current step.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Trial Contracts and Tournament games rescheduled - Patch 2.2.6 Notes - 02/24
notes.notes:
Trial Contracts

 We have changed the flow for trial contracts. This is linked to an upcoming change, to improve the new user experience. Players will automatically join a club, when they select a trial contract. The manager will get a notification when a player joins them via a trial contract.
 Managers have to specify the exact positions they require players in. Players will only see trial contracts relevant to their position by default (but it can be edited). The view of the trial contracts page has also been updated for players.

Pass completion

GK spill

5v5 AI

Half time freeze

notes.title: Match Engine Balancing and Awards update - Patch 2.2.3 Notes - 01/27
notes.notes:
These are the changes added in this weeks patch.

Match engine balancing
The fail % chance for GK save & parry has been increased, to accommodate the changes made for the reaction logic recently. We’ve also made some tweaks to the reaction logic, to be less extreme and to limit the max bonus to 20%. 

Resolve timer accuracy
We’ve fixed some situations which were not causing the resolve timer to adjust correctly. This also includes when some fight for ball situations which were getting initiated incorrectly.

Match rating bugs
We’ve identified a few bugs with the match rating calculations. We will continue to monitor these 

New club logo 
The logos for new clubs were not saving correctly. This has been fixed, so any clubs impacted by this bug should be able to edit their logo now. 

Match centre display
Fixed the match centre (on club page) displaying a tournament which the club has unregistered from.

Season awards
We’ve made some improvements to the formulas used for the season awards, that will come into effect at the end of this season.

As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Reaction logic update and match changes - Patch 2.2.2 Notes - 01/13
notes.notes:
These are the changes added in this weeks patch.

Reaction logic
We’re introducing a new metric in the match engine, which will give more importance to where the user interacts with the ball. This new logic applies to most actions without the ball. The basic logic is that if a player has more time to react, they improve their chances of succeeding the action. Please view the image below for a visual representation.

https://i.imgur.com/mqVh6ap.png

This logic applies to the following actions:

 Tackle hard
 Sliding tackle
 Receive low & high
 Block
 Save
 Tackle with hands

GK actions
Punch is only available to be used on passes & crosses. In some extreme cases it will be available for slow shots too. 
Punch now provides a much bigger boost for the GK in fight for ball situations.
The distance of a parry is now fixed, depending on the speed of the incoming shot/cross.

Bot GK running out
We’ve fixed the bug causing AI goalkeepers to run out of their box for no reason. 

Shots over the bar
A bug with the new randomness calculations caused a shot going over the bar to be a goal. Surprisingly, it wasn’t linked to the previous bug for shots over the bar but has now been fixed.

Shirts not displayed 
In quick matches, the player shirts were not displayed on the turn panel which has been fixed. 

Retrain for expired characters
Fixed a bug allowing expired characters to train with the retrain functionality. 

As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: SEASON 3 IS COMING! - Patch 2.2.1 Notes - 01/06
notes.notes:
End of Season 2

 Please make sure to offer your players contracts for Season 3 if you wish to keep them playing. Details on the Season 2 player awards will be released in the near future. Thanks to everyone who participated in the tournaments this season. We will start registration for the next season shortly. We will be introducing more tournaments during Season 3, as part of some big changes over the next few months!

Shots over the bar

 We’ve fixed the recent bug where shots going over the bar lead to a goal.

Match HUD

 The commentary on the side has been reintroduced for those who prefer it to be constantly visible. (The centre commentary can still be opened using the hotkey.)
 The bug causing the formation panel to randomly open during a match has also been fixed.

Manager Traits

 Some bugs related to manager levels & traits have been fixed. Managers should gain 1 trait point per level now. 

Notification errors

 Fixed some bugs with automated notifications, which weren’t being displayed to the right characters.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Giving you more information about your turn choices! - Patch 2.2.0 Notes - 12/30
notes.notes:
Randomness
We’ve added a panel under the scoreboard, which will display a summary after each turn. You can look at data from previous turns, however the panel will close if your character is required to make an action. 

All interactions with the ball will be displayed on the panel. There are 3 possible outcomes for every action, however some are not always applicable:

 Positive (green) - The action outcome is exactly how the user performed
 Partial positive (yellow) - The action outcome is successful, but there is some randomness applied (e.g. a pass not going exactly where aimed)
 Negative (red) - The player failed the action

In actions which have a “head to head” nature such as a fight for ball or tackle, the player(s) from each team are represented by one bar in the colour of their shirt. You can see in the example below, the fight for ball action was 50/50 between the 2 players involved. Each shirt on the panel has an outline, to indicate the outcome of their action. The player for Silver Slayers was successful in the fight for ball, indicated by the green outline of the #72 shirt.

https://i.imgur.com/ym0ijkI.png

As well as adding the visual representation, we’ve modified the randomness calculations themselves. Although factors such as confidence & condition added some uncertainty to results, the stronger player was winning too frequently (especially if attributes were close). 

The easiest way to explain the changes is with a few numerical examples. In the examples below, a player from each team is challenging for the ball. 

https://i.imgur.com/EFv4wih.png

The attribute score is the value we give for a specific action performed out of 100, based on player attributes and other factors. I’m sure we’ll make tweaks to this formula and other factors over time, but we’d appreciate your feedback after playing some matches.

Tackling

 Fixed a bug with the tackling probabilities, as the ball was going loose too frequently after tackles.


Cup KO rounds

 Some issues with the scheduling of KO rounds have been fixed. It had to be manually done for the recent 5v5 cup match, which caused some inconsistencies on other pages.
 

Training frequency

 Some users had reported they were getting an inconsistent amount of training points. This should be resolved now, to just 1 training per day per character.
 

Club forum

 Fixed some UI bugs with the club forum and some permission issues when editing posts.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Match HUD changes, bug fixes and... Beards - Patch 2.1.6 Notes - 12/16
notes.notes:
This is what's been updated in todays patch, which has seen quite a few changes and fixes.

Improved security

 We’ve added encryption and additional security measures to all our APIs. We have done extensive testing of all aspects of the game and have not identified any bugs as a result of these changes.


Match HUD

 We’ve improved multiple aspects of the Match HUD. Your character should now always be displayed in the bottom left, so you can see the condition/confidence of your player(s) easily.
 We’ve fixed some bugs with the manager panel, as well as giving visual indicators of the player familiarity in their current position. We also give visual indication when a tactical change is pending and give the opportunity for the manager to undo changes. There are some minor bugs identified with the undo feature, which will be addressed in a future patch.
 The squad list now displays more information on the players of both teams. Users can see real time updates to the match rating and player confidence. This will also make it easier to identify issues with the match rating formula (feedback from you guys is appreciated here).
 All panels are displayed in the middle of the screen now. We’ve assigned hotkeys to each panel so you can quickly open/close a panel. The hotkeys can be updated in the system settings as always. 

Match timeouts

 Our developers found one cause to some of the connection issues that have been reported in recent weeks/months. This should reduce the frequency of match timeouts in quick matches. 

Assist bug

 We’ve fixed a bug with how assists were being recorded. Previously, assists were only recorded if a goal was scored directly after receiving the ball.

Player rating

 Further improvements to the player rating logic have been applied. Some of the data for position specific stats was not being saved correctly. 

Match stats

 Fixes have been applied to some of the player stats. This includes successful dribbles, tackles, fight for balls, cross completion and throw-ins. If you identify more stat errors (for players, clubs or tournaments) please let us know. 

Contract renewal

 A bug with renewing contracts of players over 21yo has been fixed. The panel was not displayed previously.


Special action bug

 One of our users identified an issue with special action training on characters owned by other users, which has been fixed now. 

Beard colour

 The correct beard colour for players should now be visible during matches.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Gameplay changes and bug fixes - Patch 2.1.5 Notes - 11/27
notes.notes:
The additions and fixes this week are as follows: 

We identified the root cause of the problem with shooting (from an angle). This should be fixed, but with more data we’ll be able to confirm. We’ll keep an eye on it over the next few days/weeks.

The accuracy formula for passing & crossing has been adjusted. It should ensure that extreme cases of bad luck don’t cause a pass to go in the opposite direction for low attribute players.

We made some adjustments to the speed dribble formula. It should be a more noticeable “boost” in speed, however you are more likely to be tackled if an opponent can reach you.

Still some match lobby freezes/crashes have been present. We believe this is due to temporary disconnection to the server in the game lobby. We have added some more logs to help identify this.

We’ve fixed the alignments of the goal posts for 11v11 and 5v5. Apologies for any goals conceded due to the misalignment! 

The retrain attribute feature has been updated, as it wasn’t using the updated wages logic. 

Some characters were not increasing in age properly, due to some server downtime on the birthday of these characters. A script will be used to update the age properly. 


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Bug fixes - Patch 2.1.3 Notes - 11/20
notes.notes:
The additions and fixes this week are as follows: 

Match events have been fixed in the post match lobby.

A bug has been fixed for the player rating (0 - 100) score, given to all footballers. This will update every Sunday and reward active users with a higher score.

We identified some issues related to wages, which have now been fixed. We’re also giving training feedback, to show more detailed data after completing training. 

Fixed an issue causing the game to crash at the end of a tournament match and stats not being recorded. 

The bug causing a few characters to be incorrectly deleted, due to inactivity, has been fixed. We sincerely apologise to the users impacted by this bug. 

The formation for the post match lobby should now display properly, with correct positions. 


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: New Tutorials and Match changes - Patch 2.1.2 Notes - 10/30
notes.notes:
The additions and fixes this week are as follows: 

We have completely restructured the tutorial for new users. We take them through some training drills, to understand the core mechanics of the game in a challenging format. That’s followed by some new match scenarios, where we put the user in particular “moments” of a match.

The movement of a player after a tackle has been changed. It was based on momentum previously, but now it will just reduce overall movement. A soft tackle will allow the tackler to move much further than a player attempting a sliding tackle.

The interaction point for goalkeepers has been reworked. Now, if a goalkeeper can only reach the edge of a shot, their chances of success will be reduced.

High pass and low pass options have been added to corner kicks.

Fixed the text colour of shirt numbers, to adjust depending on the shirt colour in matches. The text colour of each club on the resolve timer has also been fixed to be consistent with the club colours.

The manager paint line has been made easier to use. The manager just had to click a point on the pitch and a horizontal line will be drawn across the pitch. We expect this to be much more useful for offside traps and defensive lines. The lines also have a slightly higher thickness.

A bug with match rating has been fixed, where the rating could be over 10.

Users can now use ESC to cancel watching videos in the tutorial section.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Bug fixes and Discord Bot - Patch 2.1.1 Notes - 10/09
notes.notes:
The additions and fixes this week are as follows: 

 We have introduced a bot to our Discord server. The function of the bot is to announce to our users when quick matches are being created in the game. The main objective is to be able to support new users, as well as giving existing users more of an opportunity to play ad-hoc games.

 We have made an enhancement to our resolve timer calculations. Our current implementation would round the timer, which would give the defending team an advantage in some situations - particularly dribble actions. Please let us know if you encounter any bugs with this change to the resolve timer. 

 We have applied an additional change for the squad number feature. Existing players with duplicates have had their number forcibly changed now.

 We’ve also added some wage restrictions on the contract page, to combat the farming characters. There is still enough room for managers to offer more/less money depending on their situation - it just eliminates the extremes. It is also clearer for managers what the “optimal” wage is for 18-21yo footballers.

 Match ratings have been tweaked for each position. We have also fixed some bugs related to stats being tracked on the character page. We are aware of an issue with assists being registered, which will be fixed in a future patch.

 Managers will now have a restriction of 30 days after they leave a club, before they can create another. This is to combat users consistently creating new clubs and using the funds to “farm” their characters on high wages.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Season Two Restart! - Patch 2.1.0 Notes - 10/01
notes.notes:
We know it's been a little while since our last update but we have been working hard on fixing these changes and testing them. We're massively looking forward to season two and hope you guys are too!

The fixture scheduling bug has been resolved. We have added more logging, so if the issue occurs again we can quickly identify the source of the bug. With this change, we can finally restart season 2!

The kick-off issue, where players sometimes get moved to the opposition half, has been resolved. If this continues to occur please let us know details of the match.

Managers will now be able to edit the squad numbers of players in their club. This will ensure no duplicate numbers are allowed in the squad. 

Substitutions will now be displayed as a match event. When a goal is scored, the name of the players scoring the goal and the player providing the assist (where applicable) will be displayed. The event time has been reduced from 6 seconds to 3 (for things like kick-off, goal kicks etc).

More colours have been made available for club kits and cosmetic items.

The matchmaking timer for quick matches has been reduced to 5 minutes.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Season One coming to an end! - Patch 2.0.78Notes - 08/05
notes.notes:
Firstly the current season, Season One, will be closing on the 9th of August 2020. Please make sure to renew contracts of players you wish to keep at your club. We will introduce other tournament formats later this month as part of the season 2 launch.

Bug Fixes

 Goalkeepers should now be able to interact with passes & crosses at short range. 

 Active tournament tiles on the club page have been fixed.

 Hotkeys won't be triggered when using the chat window during matches.

 A bug with replays has been fixed and previous replays are now unavailable to watch due to the fix.

 The Chile flag styling has been fixed to match other flags.

 Fixed some post match summary bugs where data was not displayed.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Steam Achievements updated and bug fixes - Patch 2.0.7 Notes - 07/27
notes.notes:
Steam Achievements have been updated and some bug fixes for this weeks update.


 The Steam achievements for the game have been updated.
 Goalkeepers should now be able to interact with passes & crosses at short range. Previously they were unable to interact in the block area with their hands, which was unrealistic. 
 Some enhancements have been made for when users quickly select a move from the action menu. We will be adding a visual indicator in the future, so users know when their action is received by the server.
 Fixed some of the recent match freeze issues.
 Fixture dates are now displayed on the tournament pages.
 Footballers should now have the option to disable manager paint during matches.
 Bot goalkeepers should attempt saves more frequently.
 Fixed bugs with filters on the seasons pages.
 Some bugs related to spectating a match have been fixed.
 The order of players in tournament match intros has been fixed.
 Some of the wording on contract pages has been fixed.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Reconnect to games already in process- Patch 2.0.6 Notes - 07/15
notes.notes:
New features

 Users are now able to join season matches at any point, not just before kick-off. Also, if a user is disconnected during a match, they are able to rejoin. 
 When a user receives a message from another user, they will receive a pop-up when logging in to notify them.


Match engine bugs

 Increased the ball speed of all actions. The previous increase wasn't enough due to the resolve timer logic.
 Fixed a bug which stopped the ball crossing the line for bot goalkeepers.
 Players with high agility were able to run faster than they should, which has been fixed. 
 Fixed a bug preventing players from moving in the same turn after passing/shooting in phase 1.
 When a sliding tackle was used successfully, the tackled player received a speed reduction for the remainder of the match incorrectly. 
 Fixed a bug where the position of the tackler didn’t update properly. 
 Reduced the chance of bot defenders running to their goal line.
 Reduced the condition lost when players run.
 The potential randomness has been reduced on longer distance passes, for players with high passing attributes.
 Fixed the bug causing goalkeepers unable to receive the ball outside their box.
 Fixed a bug in seasons matches preventing goalkeepers to aim the parry & punch.
 The alignment of the goalposts in 11v11 matches have been fixed.
 Fixed a bug allowing bot players to receive high passes in the block zone.
 Fixed the bug causing some dribbles into the goal leading to a goal kick rather than a goal. 


Season bugs

 Fixed subs not going through at half time during season matches.
 Various lineup bugs showing duplicate players and replacing real characters with bot players have been fixed.
 Fixed the bug which didn’t display footballers on the squad page to some users.
 Fixed the bug preventing some tournament matches being spectated. 
 Fixed some calculation bugs for club net worth. 


Other bugs

 Fixed a bug where goal events were being displayed incorrectly after a yellow card.
 A score display bug at the start of some matches has been fixed.
 Fixed a bug where the tab order between multiple characters was not consistent.


As always, you can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Bug fixes and changes to some match logic- Patch 2.0.5 Notes - 07/01
notes.notes:
Here's this weeks changes:


 We have added logic to remove inactive footballers, managers and clubs on a regular basis. This avoids the system being flooded by new users who don't return.

 Trial contracts will now expire after 7 days. The manager will get a notification once it has expired. The manager will need enable the trial contract again if they require more players.

 Fixed some of the errors with matchmaking logic in ladder tournaments. It will aim to not pair the same clubs against each other on consecutive days and ensure a fair balance of home & away matches.

 Fixed some situations when receive options were not available when they should have.

 The first 25% of a cross and driven pass is now not receivable. 

 We have fixed bot defenders running to the goal line. There may still be some situations which cause them to do it, but the most common causes have been identified.

 The alignment of posts have been tweaked slightly to ensure they are in sync with the pitch design.
 
 Fixed a display bug on the footballer page which displayed previous wage of players without a contract.

 The minimum age value on the football page has been fixed.



You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: More Match Engine and Seasons bug fixes- Patch 2.0.4 Notes - 06/24
notes.notes:
We've added a link to our discord server on the game homepage.

Match engine


 Fixed the match freeze caused by driven pass.
 Agility has more of an impact when changing direction with momentum. Momentum has been reduced slightly in the running speed calculations.
 Fixed a bug where AI defenders would run to the goal line needlessly. 
 The condition lost after performing actions in a match has been reduced.
 We've set a minimum distance for block rebounds, so they should always be visible to players.
 Additional formations have been updated for kick-off starting positions.
 Resolved a bug causing a player to be incorrectly given as offside after receiving a block.
 Fixed a bug related to how dribble success % was calculated.
 Resolved an offside bug when an outfielder is behind the goalkeeper.


Seasons


 Tournament matches now give the option to do a quick throw-in (positions are not reset) or a regular throw-in.
 Fixed a bug where timezones were not displayed correctly on sliders.
 The timezone we detect will now appear in other places we display times, to avoid confusion when arranging matches and setting preferred playing times.
 Deleted characters should not appear in the leaderboard now.
 We've resolved some display bugs for player stats on the character screen.
 The number of clubs displayed in the tournament page should update correctly now.
 The script for player rating adjustments, mentioned in the previous patch, has now been enabled.



You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Further Season and Match bug fixes - Patch 2.0.3 Notes - 06/16
notes.notes:
Match engine

We've updated the zones in the 11v11 pitch where shooting & crossing actions can be attempted. 
As a result of this change, we haven't had any issues with gk menu options being unavailable. We will continue to monitor it.

Passing and crossing randomness has been increased, for lower skill levels. Hard shots randomness has also been adjusted.

Another fix has been implemented to stop bots being able to intercept passes in the block zone. 

The team UDP is now calculated from all characters on the pitch, rather than just active players.

Fixed a bug related to how dribble success % was calculated.

Fixed a bug where bot players would receive balls from offside positions.

We've fixed some offside bugs, but there are still some scenarios recently identified which will be fixed in a future patch.

The default starting positions from goal kicks has been updated, to match the kick-off positions.

Seasons

We now restrict tournament sign-ups to clubs that have at least 3 footballers. This is to avoid inactive matches as much as possible!

Clubs now have the option to unregister for a tournament, on the tournament overview page. Clubs are restricted to being registered to no more than 3 tournaments at once. 

Player overall ratings have been fixed. They will update based on the following factors:
- How much training your character has done
- Player performance, with unique criteria for each position
- User activity in seasons matches
- Average match rating in seasons matches
Note: This will take some time to reflect in live as it requires an additional script to be run.

You can now view a club directly from the tournament overview or standings page.

Half time stats should be appearing consistently in tournament matches.

All subs should now appear in the tournament intro scene.

We've adjusted the column widths in the squad page to give more space for player names.

Fixed a bug when a contract renewal offer was rejected it caused the game to freeze.

Fixed a bug where the club bank balance was not always updating correctly after player training.

Other

Cosmetics are applied by default after purchasing. 

The timezone we have detected for you is now displayed in the toolbar. 



You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Season and Match bug fixes - Patch 2.0.2 Notes - 06/08
notes.notes:
Match engine

 The default ball speeds for all actions has increased by 10-15%. This is still a work in progress and we may increase it further in the future. 

 Fixed the bug allowing bot players to intercept the ball in unrealistic positions. 

 Fixed some inconsistency with player morale during matches. After positive actions it would not update properly. 

 After a failed dribble, a player cannot attempt to tackle an opposition player straightaway. 



Season

 Fixed the match loading bugs experienced by some users in tournament matches. More logging has been added, so if this continues to happen we will have better data to analyse the issue. There are some syncing issues with the pre-match lobby still, but this should have no impact with the gameplay.

 Fixed the tournament intro not loading for some players, giving them a blank pitch for the duration of the intro.

 Fixed the bug when a club enters multiple ladder tournaments and has a shared ELO instead of unique ELO for each ladder. 

 Fixed some of the tournament stats showing incorrectly, for both player & club tab.

 The post match lobby score and match events should now display correctly for tournament matches. 

 Fixed the inconsistency displaying additional position points as well as player value.

 Filter and sorting bugs on the tournament page have been fixed.

 Fixed the default match time slider in th tournament page to display all times. A bug with local times and the match time slider will be worked on soon. 

 Fixed a bug where players are able to use the paint tool in tournament matches.
 
 Fixed a bug where both teams can see paint drawn.

 If a manager fails to repond to a friendly match invite, the opposition manager can now re-invite them. It was previously blocked by the expired invite.

 Manager notes in a match lobby now save properly.

 Fixed the freezing on the customise logo screen.


Other

 The positions for each formation have been fixed. Some unused formations have been removed.

 Fixed some player stat bugs and no longer includes quick matches in lifetime stats.

 Fixed the credits log, which allows users to see when credits are added or deducted from their account.

 A bot player controlled by the manager using pro license can now be subbed off the pitch.




You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Bug Fixes - Patch 2.0.1 Notes - 05/22
notes.notes:
Tournament registration has been fixed. Clubs are able to join the ladder tournaments again.

Some match engine bugs introduced in the last patch have been resolved.

Match availability will now apply to all characters owned by a user, rather than having to update it individually.

A bug when subbing a bot player controlled by the manager has been resolved.

You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Register for Tournaments now - Patch 2.0.0 Notes - 05/08
notes.notes:
Tournament registration page is now available to use. For now, we are just having 2 ladder tournaments at 20:00 UTC and 02:00 UTC. Ladder matches have daily matches scheduled and uses an ELO rating system to calculate changes on the ladder. After registering for a tournament, a manager will need to opt-in to play for the next fixture.

Player & club stats, fixtures and awards for the current season and previous seasons are also active on a tournament page.

The match centre now displays upcoming fixtures and registered tournaments. You can access the match lobby from there, rather than the club calendar.

Bug fixes
- Some scenarios causing match freezing have been identified and handled. We expect there will be more cases, so please let us know when you encounter an issue. 
- Sliding tackle has been added to action menu.
- The 11v11 pitch outline for level 1 stadiums has been fixed.
- AI centre midfielders will stop moving backwards from kick-offs


You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Tournaments Are Here - Patch 1.6.7 Notes - 04/29
notes.notes:
Tournament features are now enabled. We are starting with daily ladders, to test connectivity and server capacity. Each day at the specified ladder time, fixtures will be generated against other teams in the ladder. We will trial leagues once the ladder tournaments are stable.

The match centre on your club page should now display upcoming fixtures (friendly & tournament). It also displays the tournaments the club is active in, so new players can easily see when matches are. A club can only take part in 3 active tournaments at once.

Club forums are now enabled. We suggest using it to give new users basic guidance and possibly direct them to a discord server or something easy to chat in, with other teammates. A match thread will automatically be generated in the forum for each fixture, if you wish to add scouting notes etc.

Characters are now able to message each other in game. Please let us know if you experience any issues with this (and capture screenshots if possible) as it's a super important feature to help new users!

We have made some adjustments to the player movement formulas. This impacts speed & acceleration attributes, as well as momentum slightly. We'll be making some adjustments to the ball speeds and player agility soon.

Tutorial videos have been added, to give a brief overview of the game features for new users.

Bug fixes
- Our bots were very hesitant to use high passes, which often meant their low passes would get intercepted. There should be more of a balance between low and high passes now.
- Some 11v11 formations caused a bug related to the kick-off circle.
- Penalty kick position has been fixed for 11v11.
- Managers should now get the appropriate number of trait points after levelling up. 
- Some bugs leading to the goalkeeper interaction problems have been identified and fixed.
- Some issues with kit colours has been fixed. There are still more fixes to come to display kits correctly in the match.
- Some win rate bugs have been fixed in the leaderboards.
- Some missing nationalities have been added.
- When going to your player profile, the "view as" should change to that character by default now.
- The key bugs related to offering contracts have been resolved.
- Players can not be offside for throw-in and goal kicks.

You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Super Club Soccer - Patch 1.5.10b Notes - 04/13
notes.notes:
Although we have fixed the custom build bug in new characters, we still had to find a solution for the existing characters. Only a small number of characters were intentionally created to abuse the bug, so we didn't want to punish all characters with a full reset. During investigation we identified another bug, which made it harder to separate the bugged characters from the rest. We have come to a solution which will be fair to all and effective immediately. 

All users who made a custom build character will have to re-skill their character, due to the previous bugs. Any training done since creation will be added to the total attribute points. You will have 24 hours after logging in, to re-skill characters without impacting your club bank balance. Please note, you may experience a long loading time after applying the new attributes.

Due to an additional training bug found, all characters have had their training reset and been given their training points to use again. So if you created your character 7 days ago, your attributes will be reset and you get 7 training points to use.

notes.title: Super Club Soccer - Patch 1.5.10 Notes - 04/10
notes.notes:
Addressed the bugs below in this update.

Custom build
-The bug for custom build characters, where attributes under 50 were being doubled, has been resolved. 

Club net worth
-The net worth of clubs should now update properly. If you see your bank balance not updating after club friendly matches please let us know.

Bank balance boost
-Due to the delay to the start of the season, all bank balances under 500k have been reset.

User match rating
-Some adjustments have been made to the match rating formula. Please let us know if you still see extreme match ratings.

Match freeze
-Some bugs related to match freezing have been identified and fixed. This mainly applied to friendly matches.

Training bug
-When training an attribute to 100, it was getting reduced back down to 99 on the attributes page. That's been fixed now.

Day Light Saving
-Match times should now be adjusted to DLS.

You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Super Club Soccer - Patch 1.5.0 Notes - 03/03
notes.notes:
With this update, we are giving a first glimpse into what our Seasons mode will be. We'll be releasing features throughout the next few weeks & months, to get the competitive gameplay started! 

Here are the features included in this release:

New footballer career paths

 All career paths start at the same age, however the rate that they improve & decline is vastly different
 Early - Expect an explosive start but be prepared for an early decline
 Mid - If consistency is what you’d prefer, then this is the build for you
 Late - Despite a slow beginning, this build has the highest potential for greatness


Player contracts

 Improve your training performance with wages
 For this patch we encourage users just to use trial contracts
 For an 18yo player, the optimal wage is 20000. After 30 days, a player increases in age and the optimal wage increases by 10000


 Manager characters introduced
 Customise the look of your manager with unique outfit options
 Create your own club or learn the ropes as an assistant manager


Profile pages
At a user & character level, we have organised the most relevant information to be displayed for you and others viewing your profile
Keep track of stats and any awards earned too


Create a club
Design your own kit and logo
Start with a small budget to recruit players on trial contracts
Challenge other clubs to friendly matches, to generate funds and build a connection with your players from around the world
Develop the club further by upgrading the club stadium and/or training ground


And also...

Coming soon
Club forums to discuss match times, match tactics & scouting info on opponents
Join tournaments and keep track of upcoming fixtures with the tournament centre
Buy and sell players to suit your club ambitions with the transfer market
Show off your achievements with tournament & season awards


You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.

notes.title: Super Club Soccer - Patch Notes - 12/09
notes.notes:
Following on from the feedback we've had since we released in early access here is the first patch notes for this new update.


 Quick Match lobbies have been changed. Our intention is to group active users together, to provide more competitive & enjoyable matches.
 The AI has also been improved. Bots should now be positioned better in open play and set pieces. Bot goalkeepers will position themselves better.
 The username of players is now displayed on the lobby formation panel, by hovering over the player.
 The scroll speed of the camera zoom during matches has been reduced.
 A bug where sub players couldn't be controlled has been resolved.
 A bug related to attribute points during character creation has been resolved.
 A leaderboard bug where all characters are not being displayed has been resolved.


Thank you all for playing and enjoying the game and we appreciate all feedback. You can leave feedback in a review, through the steam forums or you can join our Discord and raise them directly to us there.
